name: Goutham Kolla
headline: Mobile App QA Engineer | iOS & Android Testing
tagline: You get release-ready coverage, reproducible bugs with video evidence, and automation your team can keep running after handoff.
about: I specialize in mobile QA for Android, iOS, Flutter, and React Native — the kind of testing that catches payment races, network edge cases, and role-switching bugs before they hit production.
Clients hire me when a release date is fixed and they need someone who can plan coverage fast, execute deeply, and hand back actionable reports — not a vague status update.

capabilities.title: Manual & exploratory testing
capabilities.description: Full user journeys, edge cases, UI consistency, and BDD-style cases written so your team can reuse them.

capabilities.title: Mobile automation you can keep
capabilities.description: Appium / Maestro flows for regression — stable locators, readable scripts, ready for CI.

capabilities.title: Multi-device & dual-role coverage
capabilities.description: Real devices and cloud farms across screen sizes, plus Buyer/Seller or Driver/Rider style flows.

capabilities.title: Network & interrupt stress
capabilities.description: Slow 3G, offline, call interrupts, backgrounding — the failures that only show up under bad conditions.

capabilities.title: Bug reports that get fixed
capabilities.description: Severity, steps, expected vs actual, screenshots, narrated video, and logs your engineers can trust.

bullets: Designed end-to-end manual and automated test suites for UI/UX, edge cases, and BDD flows.
Built self-healing test automation scripts to streamline regression cycles.
Conducted multi-device & dual-role testing (e.g., Buyer/Seller, Driver/Rider).
Integrated QA into CI/CD pipelines and monitored performance, latency, and logs for bug reporting.

testimonials.quote: He ran a thorough manual and automated QA pass for our mobile card game across iOS and Android using BrowserStack and LambdaTest. He uncovered critical edge-case network desyncs and animation glitches that our internal team missed, providing narrated video evidence and precise logs in Jira. His Maestro/Appium automation scripts for lobby creation and continuous regression flows saved us hours of release prep.
testimonials.author: Harini
testimonials.context: Freelancer client - Mobile card game QA

testimonials.quote: Goutham did an exceptional job testing our mobile application across both iOS and Android. He handled both manual and automation testing thoroughly, providing a well-structured test plan, detailed bug reports with clear reproduction steps, and great cloud/real-device coverage.
